RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 45

An all-male selection panel at a public broadcaster often breaches internal diversity guidelines and increases the risk of affinity bias, especially given your direct tenure as deputy news editor. However, the appointment may also reflect genuine strategic priorities, such as an urgent push toward digital media.

Do not lead with accusations of discrimination. First, send a polite follow-up requesting your promised written feedback. Simultaneously, check your organization’s recruitment policies regarding panel composition and shortlist scoring. If the feedback is evasive or if policies requiring balanced panels were breached, consult your union or an employment representative to raise the procedural failure formally.
